essence: The reach to the middle leaf admits either a three-part or a half measure.
The design allows either equal width and height or an equal width proportion.
One should arrange foot ornaments and similar adornments below the leaf.
One may draw a bull on the other side of the trident.
One should place the staff in the eastern part and the trident above it.
